Position Summary The Reporting Analyst is responsible for identifying, gathering, validating, and analyzing data from multiple internal and external sources to support SAMGIs operational excellence and strategic decision-making. This role prepares high-quality reports and dashboards for client meetings, leadership discussions, board presentations, and internal performance reviews. The Reporting Analyst must have strong analytical skills, an understanding of medical and business data, and the ability to perform first-level interpretation to identify trends, risks, or anomalies before reports are shared with key stakeholders. Expertise in Power BI, PowerPoint, and storytelling with data is essential. Key Responsibilities Data Collection & Preparation Identify, request, and collect data from internal systems, hospital partners, external vendors, and third-party sources. Validate, clean, and prepare datasets for analysis, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Partner with IT, Clinical Operations, Finance, and Business Development to centralize dataflows and establish reliable data pipelines. Reporting & Analytics Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, data models, and visuals that support operational and strategic reporting needs. Develop presentation-ready reports for leadership meetings, board discussions, client performance reviews, and program updates. Summarize key findings through narratives, charts, tables, and visual storytelling to make complex information understandable and actionable. Recommend visualization methods, layout, sequencing, and report design based on SAMGI branding and data best practices. First-Level Review & Quality Control Perform initial analysis and sanity checks on all reports to ensure accuracy and relevance. Identify trends, outliers, or areas of concern that may require attention or escalation prior to presentation. Conduct reconciliation against source systems or historical reporting where needed. Ensure all reports are consistent with SAMGI definitions, metrics, and accepted methodologies. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Operations, Clinical Leadership, Finance, Recruitment, and Business Development to understand reporting requirements and evolving data needs. Support program launches, performance reviews, audits, and strategic planning meetings with accurate, timely insights. Assist presenters (Leadership, VP of Operations, Medical Directors, etc.) by preparing slide decks, supporting documents, and talking points. Serve as a resource for internal teams seeking guidance on metrics, data interpretation, and visual design. Dataflow Understanding & Storytelling Understand the lifecycle of data from intake to reporting, including sources, transformations, and business logic. Make recommendations on how data should flow to improve reliability, automation, and long-term scalability. Apply storytelling principles to ensure reports clearly communicate the why behind the data. Stakeholder Engagement & Reporting Planning Meet regularly with key internal and external stakeholders to identify reporting needs, including program statistics, performance analysis, client-facing presentations, leadership reviews, and board materials. Translate stakeholder needs into clearly defined reporting requirements, metrics, and deliverables for each hospital program. Develop, maintain, and manage a master reporting calendar that tracks report delivery dates, standing meetings, ad hoc requests, and presentation timelines across all programs and departments. Coordinate report preparation and delivery to ensure deadlines are met and materials are aligned with the intended audience and meeting objectives. Proactively anticipate upcoming reporting needs based on program cadence, contract requirements, and leadership priorities. Requirements Qualifications Bachelors degree in Business, Analytics, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 25 years of experience in reporting, analytics, business intelligence, or data visualization. Strong proficiency in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, visualization design). Advanced PowerPoint skills, including slide design, sequencing, and professional presentation formatting. Familiarity with other analytics tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, Power Query, DAX, Power BI) preferred. Ability to understand medical terminology, healthcare operations, and business metrics. Strong critical thinking, attention to detail, and analytical problem-solving skills. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate data into meaningful insights. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Working Conditions Remote or hybrid work flexibility, with occasional travel for onsite meetings, trainings, or client presentations. May require extended hours during .

Job Title: Data Analyst

Experience: 5+ Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location: Remote

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data and analytics initiatives by translating complex commercial business processes into accurate analytical models and SQL logic. The role requires strong expertise in SQL, cloud data environments, data visualization and commercial analytics.

The candidate will work closely with business teams to understand requirements, validate data and develop reliable dashboards and analytical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Translation & SQL Development

• Translate complex commercial processes such as sales, seasonal rebate programs, sales returns and marketing campaign performance into accurate and documented SQL logic.

• Write, optimize and maintain complex SQL queries and views using Amazon Redshift and Databricks.

• Extract, transform and validate data to support reporting, visualization and analytics initiatives.

• Map and validate data across systems including SAP SD, Salesforce and digital business platforms.

• Ensure business rules and commercial processes are accurately represented in the data layer.

Commercial Analytics & Dashboarding

• Design, build and maintain QlikSense dashboards.

• Develop analytical models to track regional commercial KPIs.

• Analyze sell-in and sell-out data to identify market trends, demand patterns and potential inventory issues.

• Perform deep-dive analysis of sales campaigns, loyalty programs and promotional effectiveness.

• Provide actionable insights to support business decisions.

Data Quality & Governance

• Collaborate with data engineering teams to optimize data pipelines, tables and views in Databricks and Redshift.

• Develop validation queries to identify data anomalies and ensure data quality and consistency.

• Validate analytical results against source systems.

• Support accurate and reliable data consumption for BI and analytics teams.

Required Skills & Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics or a related analytical role.

• Strong expertise in SQL, including complex joins, CTEs and query optimization.

• Hands-on experience with Amazon Redshift and/or Databricks.

• Experience working with large datasets in cloud data environments.

• Good knowledge of QlikSense or similar data visualization tools.

• Understanding of data warehousing concepts, including Star/Snowflake schemas and dimensional modelling.

• Experience working with commercial, sales and marketing data.

• Understanding of Order-to-Cash, distributor/retailer channels, pricing, sales incentives and marketing campaign tracking.

• Experience with source systems such as SAP SD and Salesforce/SFDC.

• Strong data validation and analytical skills.

• Ability to translate business requirements into technical SQL specifications.

• Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

• Ability to work effectively with business and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

• Experience in AgTech, Crop Protection, Seeds, FMCG or related manufacturing/distribution environments is preferred.

• Experience working with structured distribution networks and commercial datasets is an advantage.

About the Role
• We are looking for an experienced Director – Investment Banking (TMT) to lead the execution of M&A, capital raising, and corporate finance transactions for SMEs and mid-market companies.
• The Director will take significant ownership of live transactions, seller relationships, buyer and investor engagement, transaction strategy, stakeholder coordination, and deal team management.
• This is a hands-on senior execution role for an experienced investment banking professional who can independently manage multiple mandates, work directly with founders and senior stakeholders, and lead analysts and associates through the full transaction lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
Transaction Execution
• Lead end-to-end execution of M&A, capital raising, and corporate finance transactions
• Take ownership of multiple live mandates from onboarding through transaction completion
• Develop and manage transaction strategy, timelines, workstreams, and execution priorities
• Coordinate with clients, buyers, investors, lawyers, advisers, and other transaction stakeholders
• Identify and resolve transaction bottlenecks, execution risks, and commercial issues
• Lead negotiations and transaction discussions where required
• Maintain execution momentum and drive transactions toward successful completion
• Ensure high standards of transaction management across multiple concurrent mandates

Seller Onboarding & Client Management
• Engage directly with founders, business owners, and prospective sellers
• Assess transaction readiness, deal objectives, and suitability of potential mandates
• Advise clients on transaction preparation, process structure, positioning, and execution
• Manage senior client relationships throughout the transaction lifecycle
• Set and manage expectations around timelines, valuation, buyer engagement, and deliverables
• Act as a senior point of contact for clients during live transactions

Buyer & Investor Engagement
• Lead and support identification of strategic buyers, financial investors, and other relevant counterparties
• Manage buyer and investor outreach and engagement strategies
• Facilitate introductions, management discussions, negotiations, and follow-ups
• Build and maintain relationships with buyers, investors, advisers, and other market participants
• Maintain momentum and competitive tension throughout transaction processes

Team Leadership
• Manage, mentor, and develop analysts, associates, and other execution professionals
• Allocate transaction responsibilities and oversee execution across the deal team
• Review financial models, valuations, transaction materials, research, and client deliverables
• Maintain strong quality control and execution standards
• Provide guidance on complex transaction and commercial issues
• Improve internal transaction processes, workflows, templates, and execution efficiency
• Support the continued development and scaling of the investment banking team

Requirements
• 8+ years of relevant experience in investment banking, M&A advisory, transaction advisory, corporate finance, private equity, or corporate development
• Strong experience executing completed M&A, capital raising, or corporate finance transactions
• Demonstrated ability to independently lead multiple live transactions and deal workstreams
• Experience working directly with founders, business owners, senior management teams, buyers, and investors
• Experience managing and reviewing the work of analysts and associates
• Strong understanding of M&A processes, transaction structuring, valuation, financial analysis, due diligence, and deal execution
• Experience within Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT) transactions would be strongly preferred
• Transaction exposure across Southeast Asia or other international markets would be advantageous
• Strong commercial judgement, project management, negotiation, and stakeholder management capabilities
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, transaction-driven environment

Compensation
• Competitive fixed compensation together with a performance-linked bonus based on individual contribution, team performance, and transaction outcomes.

Career Opportunity
• The successful candidate will have significant ownership of transaction execution and client relationships while playing an important role in developing the investment banking platform.
• The position offers the opportunity to lead complex transactions, work directly with founders, buyers, and investors, build and mentor a growing deal team, improve execution processes, and gain meaningful international transaction exposure.
• This role is suited to an experienced investment banking professional looking for broader mandate ownership, senior client responsibility, leadership exposure, and a clear path toward further senior leadership within the platform.

Professional Services Senior Project Manager

Location: Remote (AUS and APAC Time Zone)

Department: Professional Services (PS)

About the Team

Rubrik Professional Services transforms possibilities into outcomes. Our portfolio of services uncovers and exploits the unique opportunities made possible by Rubrik technology. Drawing on our unparalleled product expertise and customer experiences, we collaborate with customers to identify and address complex technical challenges, improve operational efficiency, and maximize their investment in Rubrik.

We are 100% focused on customer success, operational excellence, and empowering our team members to grow, lead, and innovate.

About the Job

Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realization, and operational efficiency.

Beyond managing high-stakes client engagements, you will serve as an expert in project management within the organization helping to mentor and coach other Project Managers and actively contributing to the development, refinement, and scaling of our PMO governance model, processes, and delivery frameworks.

About You

As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organization, you will drive impact across three core areas: Delivery Excellence, Leadership & Mentorship, and Practice Enablement.

1. Project & Client Delivery Excellence

  • Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
  • Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
  • Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales, Technical Account Managers), and third-party partners.
  • Quality & Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.

2. PMO Governance & Process Optimization

  • PMO Governance: Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
  • Continuous Improvement: Audit project workflows and delivery tools to identify bottlenecks, driving initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Assist in establishing best practices for resource allocation, utilization tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.

3. Leadership & Mentorship

  • Coach & Mentor: Serve as a mentor to associate and mid-level PMs, providing guidance on client management, conflict resolution, scope control, and career growth.
  • Thought Leadership: Share best practices, templates, and lessons learned across the team to foster a culture of continuous learning and high performance.

Qualifications & Ideal Profile

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organization.
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification 
  • Proven experience building or scaling PMO governance models supported by AI, standard delivery methodologies, and project health tracking processes.
  • Track record of managing multiple complex, high-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring, coaching, and developing junior to mid-level project managers.
  • Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.
  • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Preferred / Plus Qualifications:

  • Technical Background: Prior hands-on experience or foundational knowledge in Data Management, Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), Data Protection, Enterprise Storage, Cybersecurity, or SaaS delivery is a strong plus.
  • Additional certifications such as Agile/Scrum (CSM, PMI-ACP), ITIL, or Prosci Change Management.
  • Strong financial acumen regarding professional services metrics (e.g., revenue recognition, margin, utilization, project profitability).
